login.title: Sign in
login.welcome: Confirm purchase orders, submit quotations, reconcile payables and discuss quality with Hoa Huy in one place.
login.chooseHint: This email has accounts at several companies. Choose the one you want to enter.
login.locked: Account temporarily locked after too many failed attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes or use "Forgot password".
login.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

otp.title: Enter verification code
otp.titleNewDevice: New device, enter the verification code
otp.hint: A 6-digit code was sent to {email}. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
otp.when: Shown only on activation, a new device or password reset
otp.resent: A new code has been sent.
otp.expired: The code has expired. Click "Resend code".
otp.tooMany: Too many wrong attempts. Click "Resend code" to get a new one.
otp.deviceNote: This device will be remembered for {days} days.
otp.noPending: Verification expired, please sign in again.

invite.title: Activate account
invite.intro: Hello {name}. Set a password for {email} at {supplier}.
invite.hint: At least 10 characters, with letters and digits.
invite.invalid: The link is invalid or has expired. Ask your company admin or Hoa Huy to send a new invitation.
invite.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
invite.short: Password must be at least 10 characters.
invite.weak: Password must contain both letters and digits.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your registered email. If an account exists we will send a reset link.
forgot.sent: If the email has an account, a password reset message has been sent. Please check your inbox.
